name: ui-elements
usage: <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zevaverbach/ui-elements@v0.1.0/components/<file>"></script> then use the tag. Optional theme: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zevaverbach/ui-elements@v0.1.0/tokens.css">. Each module registers itself; load only what you use.

tokens.notes: Optional. Components fall back to built-in light/dark values. Set data-theme="light|dark" on <html> to force a scheme.

components.description: A single to-do item with checkbox, inline edit, confirm-to-delete, optional progress steps, a Web Speech microphone button (hidden where unsupported) and drag/keyboard/touch reordering among sibling items.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Item text. Reflects to the text property.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Small eyebrow label above the text.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: If present, shows four progress steps (25/50/75/100). Checking sets 100; unchecking from 100 sets 75.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: BCP-47 language for dictation. Default: document language.

attributes.name: no-reorder
attributes.description: Hide the drag handle and disable reordering.

attributes.name: no-confirm
attributes.description: Delete on the first click instead of arm-then-confirm.

slots.name: meta
slots.description: Extra content under the text (tags, due date).

events.name: ui-delete
events.description: Delete confirmed. Cancelable; if not prevented the element removes itself.

events.name: ui-transcript
events.description: Speech-to-text result; value is the edit field after a final result is appended.

events.name: ui-reorder
events.description: Item moved among sibling ui-todo-items; the DOM is already updated.

components.notes: Place several ui-todo-items under one parent (div/ul) to get a reorderable list; reordering applies to siblings with the same tag. Keyboard: Space/Enter on the handle grabs, Arrow keys move, Space/Enter drops, Escape cancels.

components.description: A backend-agnostic chat panel that slides on and off the screen edge, with a message log, composer and a ui-send event for user messages.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Edge it slides from. Default right.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a pending bubble and disables Send.

attributes.name: backdrop
attributes.description: Show a scrim; clicking it closes the panel.

attributes.name: no-echo
attributes.description: Do not append the user's message to the log on send.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Messages as light-DOM elements with data-role="user|agent|error".

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Extra header buttons before the close button.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content between the log and the composer.

events.name: ui-send
events.description: User submitted a message. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the draft.

components.notes: Toggle from any button with panel.toggle(). Slide animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Never makes network calls: the host listens for ui-send and calls addMessage('agent', ...).

compositions.name: To-do list beside a chat
compositions.description: A reorderable list is several ui-todo-item siblings in one container; a ui-chat-panel sits at the page level and is toggled by any button. Wire ui-transcript or ui-send to your own logic.
